what: Fresh-consumer verification of the ab-wildfire-ia-escape v2026.11 private release (artifact c2c8ceb56c7ff52aaf748473e1251725c4ee86912edb9b17387e6b44d0e43da2): the worker host fetches the five released assets from earino/ab-wildfire-ia-escape release 437179999 with digest verification (the container holds no credential), then the container runs every published REPRODUCE.md step against the released bytes - package-vs-MANIFEST check, get_dataset.py verification, sha256sum -c, gate 1.5.0 re-run on the full artifact, exact-byte --accept against the shipped qualification.json, declared dependency imports, baseline reproduce (both AUC prints 0.9554, CONTRACT OK, holdout never copied into a workdir), score.py references recomputed equal to measurements.json (fixed-seed CIs reproduce exactly) - and additionally recomputes the pre-registered deciding check measurements.json records (model-minus-persistence [0.0154, 0.0871], model-minus-calendar [0.1911, 0.2998], model AUC CI [0.9382, 0.9686] entirely above 0.5, verdict headroom_demonstrated) from the released bytes through the shipped baseline/train.py and code/score.py, never reimplemented. The optional rebuild-from-source step is not run: it needs the pinned 10.4 MB publisher CSV, code/build.py refuses any other source, and REPRODUCE.md documents it as optional. Bytes never pass through the coordinator.
stopping_condition: any digest mismatch at fetch fails the job before the container starts; a gate failure, acceptance failure, baseline mismatch, reference mismatch or deciding-check mismatch fails at that step with diagnostics uploaded - none of them is a retry trigger and no figure may be quoted from a failed stage; the target repository must stay private and the flip remains the operator's single approval
